description: We are Marslılar! We are an enthusiastic team of curious, innovative 6th-grade students with a deep passion for science, technology, and space exploration.
summary: Perseverance was launched on July 30, 2020, and landed on Mars on February 18, 2021. It explored Jezero Crater, studied rocks, took pictures, and searched for signs of ancient life. It also carried Ingenuity, the first helicopter to fly on another planet. Its mission helps us understand Mars better.
details:
Our project is about NASA's Perseverance rover. It explores Mars, takes pictures, studies rocks, and searches for signs of ancient life.

Our goal is to show how space equipment helps us learn about Mars and prepare for future missions.

We used research, pictures, and presentation software. Our project is creative because we tell Perseverance's story in an interesting way.
dataRefs: Ingenuity helikopteri 19 Nisan 2021'de ilk uçuşunu gerçekleştirdi; bu, başka bir gezegende yapılan ilk motorlu uçuştu.
